import re
with open('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/config.h.cmake') as f:
    txt = f.read()

# Substitute variables
subs = {
    '${CMAKE_PROJECT_HOMEPAGE_URL}': 'https://github.com/libical/libical',
    '${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}': 'libical',
    '${PROJECT_VERSION}': '4.0',
    '${SIZEOF_INT}': '4',
    '${SIZEOF_TIME_T}': '8',
    '${SIZEOF_ICALTIME_T}': '8',
}
for k,v in subs.items():
    txt = txt.replace(k, v)

# Enable features available on Linux
enable = {
    'HAVE_BACKTRACE','HAVE_BYTESWAP_H','HAVE_ENDIAN_H','HAVE_GMTIME_R',
    'HAVE_LOCALTIME_R','HAVE_INTTYPES_H','HAVE_INTPTR_T','HAVE_ISWSPACE',
    'HAVE_DIRENT_H','HAVE_PTHREAD_GETATTR_NP','HAVE_PTHREAD_CREATE',
    'HAVE_PTHREAD_H','HAVE_NANOSLEEP','HAVE_USLEEP','HAVE_SNPRINTF',
    'HAVE_STAT','HAVE_FSTAT','HAVE_STRCASECMP','HAVE_STRNCASECMP',
    'HAVE_STRDUP','HAVE_ACCESS','HAVE_GETOPT','HAVE_GETPID','HAVE_MKDIR',
    'HAVE_OPEN','HAVE_READ','HAVE_WRITE','HAVE_SETENV','HAVE_SYS_PARAM_H',
    'HAVE_SYS_UTSNAME_H','HAVE_UNISTD_H','HAVE_FCNTL_H','HAVE_UNSETENV',
    'HAVE_ALARM','HAVE_SIGNAL','HAVE_WAITPID','HAVE_FORK','HAVE_GETPWENT',
    'HAVE_UNLINK','HAVE_WCTYPE_H','HAVE_SIZEOF_INTPTR_T','HAVE_SIZEOF_SIZE_T',
    'HAVE_SIZEOF_SSIZE_T','HAVE_SIZEOF_PID_T','HAVE_SIZEOF_WINT_T',
}
# SIZEOF_* defines
size_defines = {'SIZEOF_INT':'4','SIZEOF_TIME_T':'8','SIZEOF_ICALTIME_T':'8'}

def repl(m):
    name = m.group('name')
    rest = m.group('rest')
    if name in size_defines:
        return f'#define {name} {size_defines[name]}'
    if name == 'const':
        return '#define const'
    if name in enable:
        return f'#define {name} 1'
    # default: undef
    return f'/* #undef {name} */'

txt = re.sub(r'^#cmakedefine (?P<name>[A-Z_]+)(?P<rest>.*)$', repl, txt, flags=re.M)
with open('/tmp/build/config.h','w') as f:
    f.write(txt)
print("done")
PYEOF
